subject: [PATCH v2 1/2] lib/zstd: add fallback aliases for disabled BMI2 variants

2026-08-30.patch_summary: This patch adds fallback aliases for disabled BMI2 variants in the Zstandard library. When dynamic BMI2 dispatch is disabled, it prevents compilation of BMI2-specific functions and conditionally compiles selectors to avoid naming conflicts. The patch introduces aliases from unavailable BMI2 function names to their default implementations, making the names valid without emitting BMI2-specific code. This change does not modify existing code generation but prepares for future use of these aliases when dynamic BMI2 dispatch is enabled. The goal is to improve flexibility and maintainability by providing a fallback mechanism for disabled BMI2 variants.
